title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Ordinary to Moderate thunderstorms are expected for Parts of Germany, Poland, Austria & Czechia.

---Risk Areas---

SLGT #1
Austria & W Hungary

Moderate scattered thunderstorms are expected mainly for Austria.
The main threats are:
- Hail - up to 2cm is possible
- Heavy rain - locally up to 35+mm in 3hrs is possible

SLGT #2
N Germany

Moderate thunderstorms are expected.
The main threats are:
- Hail - up to 2+cm are possible during - isolated thunderstorms
- Wind gusts - up to 60km/h is possible
- Heavy rain - around 25mm in 3hrs is expected
- Tornado - Weak and brief tornado could form under the conditions in the area.
